description: This file defines include guards for standard C headers used within the curl project and declares a subset of standard functions like fread, fwrite, strcasecmp, and strncasecmp. It primarily serves as a configuration or wrapper header for including system standard headers in the curl project.

methods.name: fread
methods.description: Declaration of the standard C function fread for reading data from a file stream.

methods.name: fwrite
methods.description: Declaration of the standard C function fwrite for writing data to a file stream.

methods.name: strcasecmp
methods.description: Declaration of the POSIX function strcasecmp for case-insensitive string comparison.

methods.name: strncasecmp
methods.description: Declaration of the POSIX function strncasecmp for case-insensitive string comparison up to a specified length.
